title: Mazur-Ulam Theorem With Gromov-Hausdorff Distance
summary: It is shown that two Banach spaces are linearly isometric if and only if the Gromov--Hausdorff distance between them is finite, in particular, zero. The proof is compilative and relies on results obtained by many researchers on the approximability of almost-surjective almost-isometries by linear surjective isometries. In the finite-dimensional case, previously obtained by I.~Mikhailov, a simpler proof under weaker assumptions is given. In the finite-dimensional case, a criterion for isometry in terms of finite (compact) subsets is also given.
